statements.statement: 'Big' and 'large' have exactly the same meaning and can always be interchanged.
statements.statement_uz: 'Big' va 'large' aynan bir xil ma'noga ega va doim almashtirilishi mumkin.
statements.explanation: While similar, they differ in usage. 'Big' is more informal; 'large' is more formal. 'Big brother' ≠ 'large brother'.
statements.explanation_uz: O'xshash bo'lsa-da, ishlatilishida farq bor. 'Big' norasmiyroq; 'large' rasmiyroq. 'Big brother' ≠ 'large brother'.

statements.statement: The word 'terrific' means something very bad or terrible.
statements.statement_uz: 'Terrific' so'zi juda yomon yoki dahshatli narsani anglatadi.
statements.explanation: 'Terrific' means excellent or wonderful, despite sounding like 'terrible'.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Terrific' 'terrible'ga o'xshash eshitilsa-da, ajoyib yoki zo'r degani.

statements.statement: 'Affect' is a verb and 'effect' is a noun.
statements.explanation: Generally: 'affect' (verb) = to influence; 'effect' (noun) = result. Though both can rarely be other parts of speech.
statements.explanation_uz: Odatda: 'affect' (fe'l) = ta'sir qilmoq; 'effect' (ot) = natija. Kamdan-kam boshqa so'z turkumi bo'lishi mumkin.

statements.statement: A 'receipt' is what you give to pay for something.
statements.statement_uz: 'Receipt' biror narsa uchun to'lash uchun beradigan narsa.
statements.explanation: A 'receipt' is what you RECEIVE after paying. A 'payment' is what you give.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Receipt' to'lagandan keyin OLADIGAN narsa. 'Payment' beradigan narsa.

statements.statement: 'Borrow' means to take something temporarily from someone.
statements.statement_uz: 'Borrow' kimnidir dan vaqtincha biror narsani olish demak.
statements.explanation: 'Borrow' = take temporarily. 'Lend' = give temporarily.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Borrow' = vaqtincha olmoq. 'Lend' = vaqtincha bermoq.

statements.statement: 'Infamous' means very famous.
statements.explanation: 'Infamous' means famous for bad reasons, notorious. 'Famous' is for positive recognition.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Infamous' yomon sabablar bilan tanilgan, badnom. 'Famous' ijobiy taniqlilik uchun.

statements.statement: 'Eventually' and 'finally' mean the same thing.
statements.explanation: Both mean 'in the end' or 'after a long time'. They are synonyms in most contexts.
statements.explanation_uz: Ikkalasi ham 'oxir-oqibat' yoki 'uzoq vaqtdan keyin' degani. Ko'p kontekstlarda sinonim.

statements.statement: 'Sensible' and 'sensitive' have the same meaning.
statements.explanation: 'Sensible' = practical, reasonable. 'Sensitive' = easily affected, emotional.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Sensible' = amaliy, oqilona. 'Sensitive' = tez ta'sirlanadigan, hissiy.

statements.statement: A 'chef' and a 'cook' are exactly the same thing.
statements.explanation: A 'chef' is professionally trained and usually works in restaurants. A 'cook' is anyone who prepares food.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Chef' professional o'qitilgan va odatda restoranlarda ishlaydi. 'Cook' ovqat tayyorlaydigan har qanday kishi.

statements.statement: 'Valuable' means the same as 'invaluable'.
statements.explanation: 'Valuable' = worth a lot. 'Invaluable' = priceless, extremely useful (so valuable it can't be measured).
statements.explanation_uz: 'Valuable' = qimmatli. 'Invaluable' = bahosiz, juda foydali (o'lchanmas qimmatli).

statements.statement: The word 'literally' can only be used for actual, factual statements.
statements.statement_uz: 'Literally' so'zi faqat haqiqiy, faktik bayonotlar uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.
statements.explanation: While traditionally true, 'literally' is now also used informally for emphasis (though controversial).
statements.explanation_uz: An'anaviy ravishda to'g'ri bo'lsa-da, 'literally' endi norasmiy ravishda ta'kidlash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

statements.statement: 'Principal' and 'principle' are pronounced the same way.
statements.explanation: Both are homophones: /ˈprɪnsəpəl/. 'Principal' = main/school head. 'Principle' = rule/belief.
statements.explanation_uz: Ikkalasi ham omofonlar: /ˈprɪnsəpəl/. 'Principal' = asosiy/maktab direktori. 'Principle' = qoida/e'tiqod.

statements.statement: 'Desert' (dry land) and 'dessert' (sweet food) are pronounced the same.
statements.explanation: 'Desert' = /ˈdezərt/ (DEZ-ert). 'Dessert' = /dɪˈzɜːrt/ (di-ZERT). Different stress.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Desert' = /ˈdezərt/ (DEZ-ert). 'Dessert' = /dɪˈzɜːrt/ (di-ZERT). Boshqa urg'u.

statements.statement: An 'optimist' expects good things to happen.
statements.explanation: An optimist has a positive outlook. A pessimist expects bad outcomes.
statements.explanation_uz: Optimist ijobiy qarashga ega. Pessimist yomon natijalarni kutadi.

statements.statement: 'Flammable' and 'inflammable' are opposites.
statements.explanation: Surprisingly, both mean 'easily catches fire'. 'Non-flammable' is the opposite.
statements.explanation_uz: Ajablanarlisi, ikkalasi ham 'oson yonadi' degani. 'Non-flammable' qarama-qarshi.

statements.statement: The opposite of 'progress' is 'regress'.
statements.explanation: 'Progress' = move forward. 'Regress' = go back to an earlier state.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Progress' = oldinga harakat. 'Regress' = oldingi holatga qaytish.

statements.statement: 'Unique' can have degrees: 'more unique', 'most unique'.
statements.explanation: Traditionally, 'unique' means 'one of a kind' and cannot be graded. Something is either unique or not.
statements.explanation_uz: An'anaviy ravishda, 'unique' 'yagona' degani va darajalanmaydi. Biror narsa ya unique yoki yo'q.

statements.statement: 'Historic' and 'historical' have different meanings.
statements.explanation: 'Historic' = important in history. 'Historical' = relating to history in general.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Historic' = tarixda muhim. 'Historical' = umuman tarixga oid.

statements.statement: 'Lose' and 'loose' are synonyms.
statements.explanation: 'Lose' (verb) = misplace. 'Loose' (adjective) = not tight.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Lose' (fe'l) = yo'qotmoq. 'Loose' (sifat) = bo'sh, qat'iy emas.

statements.statement: A 'biannual' event happens twice a year.
statements.explanation: 'Biannual' = twice a year. 'Biennial' = every two years. Often confused!
statements.explanation_uz: 'Biannual' = yilda ikki marta. 'Biennial' = har ikki yilda. Ko'p almashtiriladi!
